verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for an incident-management SaaS, but nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer can receive. The Workflows engine has trigger events, but its documented actions cover Slack, Google Chat, Jira, on-call, AI and incident operations, with no outbound HTTP or webhook action named. Inbound alert ingestion, the REST API, the status-page JSON API and the MCP server are different capabilities and earn no credit here.
